text_block_list.text:
Just as White Day was about to end—I was 
sprinting full speed toward the academy!
It all began a few days ago—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...W-Whaaat!? Really!?

It has been about two years since I became 
her Trainer. Throughout that time, I've 
watched Yukino Bijin continue to give it 
her all from right by her side.

With White Day coming up soon, I casually 
murmured that I should get a present for 
the hard-working girl, but—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
White Day, huh... Eep, I'm so happy! I'm 
truly, truly lookin' forward to it!

And so, the search for a White Day present 
to give to Yukino Bijin began!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Something that would make Yukino-san 
happy? Whenever I brew coffee for her, she 
always seems grateful."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
However, even if you were to brew coffee, 
Trainer... it would overlap with mine, 
which wouldn't be very interesting.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry. I couldn't be of any help.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? Why the long face! This exemplary, 
Bakushin-esque Class Rep will solve your 
troubles in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm? A present for Yukino-san? There is 
only one true answer to that!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In short: a fiery, passionate race with 
Trainer! That has to be it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-san is an Umamusume with hidden 
passion... Her drive is strong enough to 
melt even the heavy snows of her hometown!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Meeting that head-on and running as 
equals is the ideal present! Human and 
Umamusume, bakushining together!"

In the end, unable to reach the ideal 
answer, I wandered aimlessly through the 
academy grounds... and happened to run 
into Gold City.
choice_data_list: U-Um! Can I ask you for some advice...?

Ah, um! Can I talk to you about 
something...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Yukino's Trainer. What's up? Wait, 
why the gloomy face?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. So that's why you've been brooding 
this whole time.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“Doesn't that mean it's not something I 
can solve, though? ...Nor anyone else 
besides me.”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The reason nothing clicks, no matter who 
you ask, is because you haven't decided 
for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"You're the one watching by her side, so 
you have to decide. —What makes it unique 
to Yukino."

I look back on the days spent with Yukino 
Bijin. The thing that constantly gave 
courage to her pure self was...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Though isn't her hometown 
Morioka?
choice_data_list:
If we go now, we'll just barely make it in 
time!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Well then, hurry along.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Yukinooo! We're having a chocolate party 
in the dorm♪ Hurry on over☆"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry! It'll just be a little longer, so 
please go ahead and eat."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …………Because it's you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Welcome back! Welcome hoooome~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to spend White Day with you. I've 
been waiting for you... Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, that present is...!
choice_data_list: Let's keep giving it our all together!

I just had to get this to Yukino, no 
matter what!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
……O-Of course! I'm going to keep on 
running!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the encouragement and the 
present, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Sesame dango! I just love 'em! That chewy 
texture and the gooey syrup, it's 
honest-to-goodness delicious..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, the wrapping too... Whoa, the 
wrapping paper is so shiny!"
choice_data_list: Picture yourself as a City Girl!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A taste of home, with the city's 
sparkle... Thank you so much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Actually, City-san gave me a word 
of encouragement: 'Just trust me and 
wait.'

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's chilly out, it feels so warm 
inside... So this is what White Day is all 
about, huh.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...S-Something so pretty, for me? Is it 
really okay... for me to have it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Sesame dango! I just love 'em! That chewy 
texture and the gooey syrup, it's 
honest-to-goodness delicious..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, WHAAAAT!? Don't tell me you came 
all the way to Morioka just for this...!?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, the wrapping too... Whoa, the 
wrapping paper is so shiny!"
